fieldNotes.DIVESTITURE: IMPORTANT — this facility is NO LONGER a J.M. Smucker site. Smucker sold its natural/organic beverage and grains businesses (incl. R.W. Knudsen and the Chico plant) to Nexus Capital Management for $110M; the deal closed Jan 31, 2022. The plant now operates under the TruRoots Company / R.W. Knudsen Family. The entrance sign in Street View reads TruRoots Shipping/Receiving, 29 Speedway.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck entrance is a long open driveway off Speedway Ave with a TruRoots Shipping/Receiving sign. No barrier arm or sliding gate is clearly visible at the entrance; trees partly obscure the driveway end. Some internal fenced enclosures exist on the property. Classified false (open) but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified at the Speedway Ave entrance or along the access road in satellite or 2024 Street View. Flagged uncertain due to tree cover at the driveway.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — no controlled truck gate was confirmed.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The access road from Speedway Ave to the docks is long with ample paved width — can hold a deep 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved truck approach and yard with unused width — physical room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Docks spread across multiple building faces; ~4-8 trailers seen backed in at a time. Estimated 10-25 total doors (overhead estimate).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated trailer-storage yard on the northwest with multiple long rows of parked trailers; 50+ trailers visible across the site, drop-stall band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Clear dedicated trailer-storage lot northwest of the plant separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 6+ large buildings — multiple manufacturing/warehouse structures plus process/tank areas.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property visible.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site is on the rural edge of Chico with orchards and farmland directly west and a low-density residential fringe south.

citations.claim: Smucker completed the $110M divestiture of its natural beverage and grains businesses (R.W. Knudsen, TruRoots) to Nexus Capital, explicitly including its manufacturing and distribution facilities in Chico, California.
Smucker announced sale of R.W. Knudsen/TruRoots incl. Chico CA facility to Nexus Capital for $110M.

verification.rationale: Chico plant divested to Nexus Capital (closed Jan 31 2022); now operates under TruRoots Co / R.W. Knudsen Family, not Smucker.
